newsitem.title: UK: New crop LIFFE wheat ends lower.
newsitem.headline: New crop LIFFE wheat ends lower.

text.p: LIFFE wheat ended with new crop lower as players liquidated positions built up on weather worries, traders said.
"Now it's rained everywhere, the concerns don't exist anymore," one trader said.
Old crop found support, although it drifted off highs reached earlier in the day at sterling's lows.
Active November last traded 0.75 stg lower at 94.00 stg on volume of 317 lots, of a total 818.
On the old crop front-month May firmed slightly on minimal volume, while July last traded unchanged at 91.50 stg on volume of 242 lots.
On barley, active November last traded 0.30 stg higher at 91.00 stg, on 52 of a total 54 lots.
Sterling recovered to above 2.78 marks in Europe's afternoon, up over one pfennig from lows.
